entries.title: Psalms 103:2
segments: The benefits which God bestows are daily renewed, and should be acknowledged with daily thanksgiving.

entries.title: Psalms 103:5
segments: Is renewed like the eagle's; so that thou art made continually vigorous and active, like the eagle, even to old age.

entries.title: Psalms 103:7
segments: His ways; his ways of dealing with his people.

entries.title: Psalms 103:10
segments: Should the Lord deal with us according to our sins, and reward us according to our iniquities, all our blessings would be taken from us, and our souls be visited with indignation and wrath.

entries.title: Psalms 103:15
segments: The uncertainty and shortness of human life should lead us to place our affections on things above, and seek the durable riches and righteousness which shall never pass away.

entries.title: Psalms 103:16
segments: The wind; the scorching wind from the Arabian desert.

entries.title: Psalms 103:17
segments: We must soon disappear and be known no more among men; but God's mercy and grace to his church shall endure for ever, and through her ministrations a multitude which no man can number shall be fitted for glory everlasting.

entries.title: Psalms 103:19
segments: The government of God extends over all the works of his hands; nothing is so high as to be above his control, or so small and obscure as to escape his notice.

entries.title: Psalms 103:22
segments: Since all places of God's dominion are full of his glorious power and goodness, they ought to be fulled with his praises.
